question: ¿Cuántos metros cúbicos de petróleo producidos en 2025 le corresponden a YPF según su participación, es decir, sumando en cada concesión la producción de petróleo multiplicada por el porcentaje de YPF en esa concesión?

attempts.query:
with fila as ( select c.id_concesion, c.ctid as r, sum(replace(substring(part from ':\s*([0-9]+(?:[.,][0-9]+)?)\s*%'), ',', '.')::numeric) as pct from sig_energia.concesion c, regexp_split_to_table(c.participacion, '
') as part where upper(trim(part)) ~ '^YPF[^A-Z]' and part ~ ':\s*[0-9]' group by c.id_concesion, c.ctid ), ypf as (select id_concesion, max(pct) as pct from fila group by id_concesion), prod as ( select idareapermisoconcesion as id, sum(prod_pet) as pet from capitulo4.produccion where anio = 2025 group by idareapermisoconcesion ) select round(sum(prod.pet * ypf.pct / 100), 2) from prod join ypf on ypf.id_concesion = prod.id
